competencies.name: Baroreceptor reflex
competencies.can: Trace the baroreceptor reflex from the carotid sinus and aortic arch through the medulla to the heart and vessels and state the response to a fall in blood pressure.

competencies.name: Hormonal control of blood pressure
competencies.can: Describe the roles of angiotensin II, aldosterone, antidiuretic hormone, and atrial natriuretic peptide in long term blood pressure control.

competencies.name: Cardiovascular response to exercise
competencies.can: Predict the change in heart rate, stroke volume, cardiac output, total peripheral resistance, and regional blood flow distribution during moderate exercise.

competencies.name: Compensation in hemorrhage and shock
competencies.can: Sequence the compensatory responses to blood loss and explain the point at which compensation fails.
